# The CD statistic {#sec-cd-theory}

Going deeper behind @sec-cd-test.

## Derivation {#sec-cd-derivation}

Under the null each $\sqrt{T}\hat\rho_{ij}$ is asymptotically standard normal
and the pairs are uncorrelated, so their scaled sum is $N(0,1)$.

## Power {#sec-cd-power}

CD has no power when positive and negative correlations cancel, for example
when a [common factor]{.term key="common-factor"} has loadings of both signs.
Squared statistics such as the LM test do not cancel, but are biased when $N$
is large relative to $T$ [@pesaran2015].
